warnings: PNG contains TWO portrait BOQ sheets laid out side by side in one landscape scan, per spec §11. Rotate the PNG 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. The physical RIGHT half is the LOWER-numbered sheet and is written to _1.json; the physical LEFT half is _2.json.

EVERY PRICE COLUMN IS BLANK ON EVERY ROW OF THE WHOLE BOQ -- ราคาหน่วยละ, จำนวนเงิน (material and labour), and รวมค่าวัสดุและค่าแรงงาน. This is a แบบ ปร.4 QUANTITY schedule issued unpriced by กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง for the estimator to fill in. Nulls are transcribed, never invented.

The title block is identical on every sheet of the set: form แบบ ปร.4, drawing numbers S-62047 / AR-61142 / SN-62034 / EE-62062 / M-62028, สถานที่ก่อสร้าง ทั่วไป, unit บาท, with ประมาณการโดย and ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ left blank.
First detail sheet of หมวดงานโครงสร้าง. Items 1.1 to 1.9; the category continues on แผ่นที่ 3/34.

*** THE REBAR SCHEDULE HERE MATCHES THE DRAWINGS' BAR SIZES EXACTLY: SR 24 at ø6 and ø9, SD 40 at ø12, ø16 and ø20. *** That is precisely the split S-01 states ('ø6/ø9 = SR-24, ø12 ขึ้นไป = SD-40') and precisely the five diameters used across S-07..S-14. ø16 dominates at 2,837 kg, consistent with it being the main bar in every column, beam and the larger pile caps.
SOLID PLANK 134 ตร.ม. confirms the precast floor system from S-01 item 4 and the SP tags on S-03/S-04. The '<300 กก./ตร.ม.' load class is a BOQ-only figure -- no structural sheet states it.

FORMWORK IS SPLIT INTO FOUR SEPARATE LINES with different quantities and units -- แบบหล่อ 310 ตร.ม., ค่าแรงแบบหล่อ 441 ตร.ม., ค้ำยัน 92 ลบ.ฟ. and เสาค้ำ 80 ลบ.ฟ. The material area (310) and the labour area (441) DIFFER, which is deliberate in Thai BOQ practice (labour counts re-use), not an error.

*** ONE UNIT LOOKS WRONG ON THE SOURCE: ตะปู (nails) 110 'ต้น'. *** Nails are normally measured in กก., and 'ต้น' is the unit that belongs with the เสาค้ำ props above. Transcribed as printed with unit_looks_wrong_on_source; not corrected.

Continuation rows (ค่าแรงแบบหล่อคอนกรีต, ค้ำยัน, เสาค้ำ, and the four bar-diameter rows) carry no item_no of their own but do carry quantities, so each is a separate item per spec §11 -- never folded into the row above.
